explication: OpenCut is a ground-up rewrite of a free video editor, but the sampled repository is an early scaffold: the web has routing and an editor route, the desktop launches a shell with editor-panel modules, and the API currently exposes health and echo endpoints. The README describes plugins, an Editor API, cross-platform Rust core, MCP, headless rendering, and scripting as planned capabilities, not evidenced runtime subsystems here. Links reflect sampled calls or routing structure; unsampled route and shell details limit further flow claims.
